entities.name: Material
entities.doc: A substance that elements are made of, such as a concrete or steel grade (MAT-01). Its behaviour law says how it responds to strain. Each property value cites the document and clause it comes from (REP-05, ADR 0018); a material gives only the properties its category uses (ADR 0019).

attributes.name: name
attributes.doc: The material's name, such as `C30/37` or `S355`.

attributes.name: category
attributes.doc: What the material is.

attributes.name: behaviour_law
attributes.doc: How stress follows strain.

attributes.name: design_code
attributes.doc: The design code the properties follow, such as `EN 1992-1-1:2004`.

attributes.name: library_key
attributes.doc: The key of the library grade the material was created from, such as `concrete/C30-37`. Unset: the material was created from scratch.

attributes.name: density
attributes.doc: Mass per unit volume, in kg/m³.

attributes.name: e_modulus
attributes.doc: Modulus of elasticity; for concrete, the secant modulus Ecm.

attributes.name: shear_modulus
attributes.doc: Shear modulus G.

attributes.name: poisson_ratio
attributes.doc: Ratio of lateral to axial strain under axial load.

attributes.name: thermal_expansion
attributes.doc: Linear thermal expansion coefficient, per kelvin.

attributes.name: thermal_conductivity
attributes.doc: Thermal conductivity λ, in W/(m·K).

attributes.name: specific_heat
attributes.doc: Specific heat capacity, in J/(kg·K).

attributes.name: fck
attributes.doc: Concrete characteristic cylinder compressive strength at 28 days, fck.

attributes.name: fck_cube
attributes.doc: Concrete characteristic cube compressive strength at 28 days, fck,cube.

attributes.name: fcm
attributes.doc: Concrete mean cylinder compressive strength at 28 days, fcm.

attributes.name: fctm
attributes.doc: Concrete mean axial tensile strength, fctm.

attributes.name: eps_c2
attributes.doc: Concrete compressive strain at the peak of the parabola-rectangle diagram, εc2, as a ratio.

attributes.name: eps_cu2
attributes.doc: Concrete ultimate compressive strain of the parabola-rectangle diagram, εcu2, as a ratio.

attributes.name: n
attributes.doc: Exponent n of the parabola of the parabola-rectangle diagram.

attributes.name: eps_c3
attributes.doc: Concrete compressive strain at the end of the rising branch of the bilinear diagram, εc3, as a ratio.

attributes.name: eps_cu3
attributes.doc: Concrete ultimate compressive strain of the bilinear diagram, εcu3, as a ratio.

attributes.name: fy
attributes.doc: Steel yield strength: fy for structural steel, fyk for reinforcement.

attributes.name: fu
attributes.doc: Steel ultimate tensile strength: fu for structural steel, ftk for reinforcement.

attributes.name: k
attributes.doc: Ratio k of the tensile strength to the yield strength, at least 1.

attributes.name: eps_u
attributes.doc: Steel strain at maximum load: εu for structural steel, εuk for reinforcement, as a ratio.

attributes.name: fm_k
attributes.doc: Timber characteristic bending strength, fm,k.

attributes.name: ft0_k
attributes.doc: Timber characteristic tensile strength parallel to the grain, ft,0,k.

attributes.name: fc0_k
attributes.doc: Timber characteristic compressive strength parallel to the grain, fc,0,k.

attributes.name: fv_k
attributes.doc: Timber characteristic shear strength, fv,k.

attributes.name: e0_mean
attributes.doc: Timber mean modulus of elasticity parallel to the grain, E0,mean.

attributes.name: e0_05
attributes.doc: Timber fifth-percentile modulus of elasticity parallel to the grain, E0,05.

attributes.name: g_mean
attributes.doc: Timber mean shear modulus, Gmean.

attributes.name: rho_k
attributes.doc: Timber characteristic density, ρk.

attributes.name: rho_mean
attributes.doc: Timber mean density, ρmean.

attributes.name: fk
attributes.doc: Masonry characteristic compressive strength, fk.

entities.name: MaterialOriginal
entities.doc: The library value of a material property that the user has since edited, kept with its source so that resetting the property restores it (MAT-02, ADR 0019). A material has at most one per property.

attributes.name: material
attributes.doc: The material whose property was edited.

attributes.name: key
attributes.doc: The name of the edited `Material` attribute, such as `fck`.

attributes.name: value
attributes.doc: The library value, in the attribute's SI unit, with the document and clause it comes from.

entities.name: Site
entities.doc: The piece of land the project stands on, and where it lies on Earth: the projected coordinate reference system, the base point, the grid rotation, the scale and an optional survey point (GEOREF-01, ADR 0017). A project has at most one site.

attributes.name: crs_epsg
attributes.doc: EPSG code of the projected coordinate reference system, such as 2154 for Lambert-93. Unset: the project is not georeferenced.

attributes.name: base_point_eastings
attributes.doc: Easting of the project base point, the origin of the local frame.

attributes.name: base_point_northings
attributes.doc: Northing of the project base point.

attributes.name: base_point_height
attributes.doc: Orthogonal height of the project base point.

attributes.name: grid_rotation
attributes.doc: Angle from the grid easting axis of the coordinate reference system to the local x-axis, counter-clockwise.

attributes.name: scale
attributes.doc: Map conversion scale from local lengths to map lengths, applied to all three axes. Finite and greater than zero.

attributes.name: survey_point_eastings
attributes.doc: Easting of the survey point, a known point such as a benchmark. Unset: no survey point.

attributes.name: survey_point_northings
attributes.doc: Northing of the survey point.

attributes.name: survey_point_height
attributes.doc: Orthogonal height of the survey point.

enumerations.name: BehaviourLaw
enumerations.doc: How the stress in a material follows its strain.

items.name: linear_elastic
items.doc: Stress proportional to strain, in tension and compression.

items.name: concrete_parabola_rectangle
items.doc: The parabola-rectangle diagram for concrete in compression (EN 1992-1-1, 3.1.7).

items.name: steel_bilinear
items.doc: Linear up to yield, then a hardening or horizontal branch (EN 1992-1-1, 3.2.7; EN 1993-1-1, 5.4.3).

enumerations.name: MaterialCategory
enumerations.doc: What a material is; it decides which properties it gives and which behaviour laws suit it.

items.name: reinforcement
items.doc: Steel bars and meshes for reinforced concrete (EN 1992-1-1).

items.name: steel
items.doc: Structural steel for members and plates (EN 1993-1-1).

items.name: timber
items.doc: Solid timber and glued laminated timber (EN 1995-1-1, EN 338, EN 14080).

items.name: insulation
items.doc: Thermal and acoustic insulation, such as mineral wool or expanded polystyrene; no structural use.

items.name: finish
items.doc: Linings, renders, plasters and claddings; no structural use.
